DDInter699.mechanism: Concomitant use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) with potassium salts may increase the risk of hyperkalemia. NSAIDs may produce potassium retention by reducing renal synthesis of prostaglandin E and impairing the renin-angiotensin system.
